_: Programs that are KNOWN red, and the exact diagnostic codes each must fail with.
This file INVERTS an assertion; it never removes one. A recorded program is still
expanded and still judged, and three things are findings: it passes (the record has
expired), it fails with a different code (a second defect was hiding behind the first),
or it fails with one more. A plain skip would be satisfied by the very defect it
excuses, which is the vacuity mode this project has shipped six times.
An entry belongs here only while a CAPABILITY the zone needs is missing from the
engine, and it names that capability in words a later session can act on. A defect a
session could fix today is fixed today; it does not become a record.
Ids are audit labels, `library/<program>`: the engine's CI audits only the rule library this
repo owns. A campaign's zone programs are judged at that campaign's release, by its pinned engine.
The rule library holds one recorded red.

exclusion.capability_gap: `causeway`'s flood stands one course below the berm's top on both flanks of a 1-wide raised spine, and `fluid-contained` refuses that body of water: 8 run directions out of its 56 cells, every one into the open corbel of `guard_cantilever` at the ward's far end (the cantilever's flanks are air from the floor up, so the post's sightline has no mass to cross). The waterline is what keeps the berm dry and the post out of a swimming body's reach; what remains is a wall under the corbel at the waterline that keeps the cantilever's slice free of standable floor, which the rule does not yet have.
